query: UPDATE password_item_entities SET metadata=$3,version=$4,grants=$5,deleting=$7,revision=revision+1,totp_key_id=$8,cleanup_due_at=CASE WHEN $7 THEN COALESCE(cleanup_due_at,now()+interval '180 seconds') ELSE cleanup_due_at END WHERE team_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND version=$6 AND revision=$9 AND deleted_at IS NULL
